notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal nonlethal damage to Body of Knowledge after it is donated to an opponent.
easyPrerequisites:
An opponent has two or more cards in hand.
Your deck size is at least 2.
description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent that has two or more cards in hand to gain control of Body of Knowledge and causing you to draw a card.
Deal nonlethal damage to Body of Knowledge.
Body of Knowledge triggers, causing its controller to draw that many cards.
Orcish Bowmaster triggers for each card drawn. Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to Body of Knowledge and causing you to amass Orcs 1.
Repeat from step 4.
